Criterion-Referenced Test (CRT)?
options_english:
It evaluates individual student performance
primarily based on a relative percentile rank

It evaluates performance against a specific
domain of learning tasks

It is explicitly designed to sort students into
normal probability curve distributions

It requires test items of medium difficulty
level to maximize the statistical spread of
students
questions.explanation_english:
A Criterion-Referenced Test evaluates an
individual's performance by comparing raw
scores directly against a pre-determined domain
of specific learning tasks, explicit competencies,
or standards of performance. CRT focuses
entirely on describing what a learner can or
cannot do within a designated content domain,
independent of how other test-takers perform on
the same assessment.
questions.explanation_hindi:
सही उत्तर (b) है। मानदंड-संदर्भित परीक्षण एक
व्यक्ति के प्रदर्शन का मूल्यांकन करता है, जिसमें
कच्चे स्कोर को सीधे विशिष्ट शिक्षण कार्यों के
निर्धारित क्षेत्र के खिलाफ तुलना की जाती है। CRT
पूरी तरह से यह वर्णन करने पर केंद्रित है कि एक
शिक्षार्थी क्या कर सकता है या नहीं कर सकता है,
बिना यह देखे कि अन्य परीक्षण लेने वाले उसी
मूल्यांकन में कैसे प्रदर्शन करते हैं।
key_facts: Criterion-Referenced Tests assess against specific competencies.
Printed answer key: (B) It evaluates performance against a specific domain of learning tasks.
They focus on individual performance, not relative ranking.
